events.text: ¡Ahí está! ¡La carrera, el remate, abajo al rincón, y el estadio estalla!
events.saw: A midfielder plays a through ball; the striker runs onto it and finishes low into the bottom-left corner.

events.text: ¡Por la derecha, supera a uno, a dos, centro raso y despejan en el primer palo!
events.saw: A winger beats two defenders down the right and whips a cross that's cleared at the near post.
A long-range strike is tipped over the crossbar by the diving goalkeeper.

events.text: ¡Salta más que nadie y la manda al techo de la red!
events.saw: From a corner, an attacker rises highest and heads it into the roof of the net.

events.text: ¡El uno-dos, el disparo, y se marcha rozando el palo lejano!
events.saw: A one-two at the edge of the box ends with a shot dragged just wide of the far post.

events.text: ¡Al contragolpe, con una frialdad total, la rosca al ángulo — sublime!
events.saw: A quick counter finishes with a curled shot into the top-right corner past the keeper.
